Air pollution caused by diesel engines is one of the biggest environmental challenges today. Industries, commercial buildings, hospitals, and construction sites often rely on diesel generator (DG) sets, which release harmful pollutants into the atmosphere. To reduce these emissions and meet environmental regulations, modern technologies like the Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device (RECD) have been developed.

Novorbis Itus is at the forefront of providing innovative emission control technologies designed to reduce diesel engine pollution while maintaining engine efficiency. In this article, we will explore what a Filter-less RECD is, how it works, and why it is becoming a preferred solution for emission control.

Understanding Retrofit Emission Control Devices (RECD)

A Retrofit Emission Control Device (RECD) is an advanced pollution control technology installed in the exhaust system of diesel engines or generator sets. The purpose of this device is to reduce harmful pollutants such as:

  • Particulate Matter (PM)
  • Carbon Monoxide (CO)
  • Hydrocarbons (HC)
  • Nitrogen Oxides (NOx)

Unlike traditional filtration systems, a filter-less RECD uses advanced catalytic and chemical processes to reduce emissions without requiring physical filters that can clog or require frequent maintenance.

What is a Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device?

A Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device is a specialized emission reduction system designed to control diesel exhaust pollutants without using a particulate filter.

Traditional emission control systems rely on filters that capture soot particles, which require periodic cleaning or replacement. In contrast, filter-less technology uses oxidation catalysts and chemical reactions to convert harmful pollutants into less harmful substances before they are released into the atmosphere.

The solutions developed by Novorbis Itus are designed to deliver high emission reduction efficiency while minimizing maintenance and operational disruptions.

How Does a Filter-less RECD Work?

A Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device works through a series of catalytic and chemical reactions that occur inside the device as exhaust gases pass through it.

1. Exhaust Gas Entry

When the diesel engine operates, exhaust gases containing pollutants are released through the exhaust pipe. These gases enter the RECD unit installed in the exhaust system.

2. Catalytic Oxidation Process

Inside the device, specially designed catalytic materials initiate chemical reactions that convert harmful gases into safer compounds. For example:

  • Carbon monoxide converts into carbon dioxide
  • Hydrocarbons oxidize into water and carbon dioxide
  • Particulate matter is significantly reduced

3. Pollutant Conversion

The catalytic structure accelerates oxidation reactions without blocking airflow, which means the exhaust gases pass smoothly through the device.

4. Cleaner Exhaust Release

After the chemical reactions take place, the treated exhaust gases exit the system with significantly reduced pollution levels.

Key Features of Filter-less RECD Technology

No Filter Blockage

Since there are no physical filters, the system avoids clogging issues commonly found in traditional filtration devices.

Low Maintenance

Filter cleaning or replacement is not required, making it a cost-effective solution for long-term operations.

Easy Installation

These systems can be retrofitted to existing diesel generators, eliminating the need to replace the entire engine system.

Regulatory Compliance

Filter-less RECD systems help organizations comply with environmental regulations such as CPCB emission standards in India.

Improved Operational Efficiency

The device allows smooth exhaust flow without increasing back pressure on the engine.

Applications of Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Devices

Filter-less RECD systems are widely used across multiple industries that rely on diesel engines.

Common applications include:

  • Diesel Generator Sets (DG Sets)
  • Construction Equipment
  • Industrial Plants
  • Hospitals
  • Commercial Buildings
  • Data Centers
  • Mining Equipment

Companies like Novorbis Itus design emission control systems tailored to meet the operational needs of different industries.

Why Businesses Are Adopting Filter-less Emission Technology

Many industries are shifting toward filter-less emission control technology because it offers both environmental and operational advantages.

Reduced Environmental Impact

Significant reduction in particulate matter and harmful gases.

Cost Savings

Lower maintenance and operational costs compared to traditional filtration systems.

Sustainable Operations

Helps businesses reduce their carbon footprint and contribute to cleaner air.

Regulatory Compliance

Ensures compliance with government pollution control norms.

Conclusion

A Filter-less Retrofit Emission Control Device is a modern and efficient solution for reducing diesel engine emissions without relying on traditional filtration systems. By using catalytic reactions instead of filters, this technology minimizes maintenance while delivering effective pollution control.
